item: 13. Theni (Ienergy) wind farm lat 9.848, lon 77.383
why: Indian Energy’s Theni phase 1 is 16.5 MW (11 × 1.5 MW Regen); all 11 turbines were installed by 19 Jul 2010, awaiting TNEB interconnection. A Renewable Energy Focus story (“Indian Theni wind farm fully commissioned”, c. 2010, CEO says completed ahead of the 9–12 months from the Dec 2009 contract) points to 2010, but renewableenergyfocus.com (503/TLS reset) and reinforcedplastics.com (404) could not be read, so no year. Capacity 16.5 MW could replace 16.

sources.quote: Thus, currently, IWFTPL is operating a 16.5 MW (11 x 1.5MW) plant.

The last 8 wind turbines have now been installed, bringing the total to 11, 1.5 MW wind turbines. The wind farm will be fully commissioned once the interconnection work at the Tamil Nadu Electricity Board substation is finished.

item: 36. Arasingundi wind farm lat 14.48, lon 76.347
